The Ceremony of Passing will be held in three moons to honor the death of Yagon. Yagon was the best of our minds. Her work birthing spectral agony into Tyria—the final plague of the seers—won our millennia-old war when she used it to ambush and kill the so-called "Immortal Leader." With the death of our enemy Sidony, and the last of the major seer ranks, Yagon granted us a sterling victory.  
  
Yagon was killed two dawns past. Her ceremony will be hosted by the Arch Steward Celsa at the edge of the Golden Lake. The ceremony will begin at dusk and will endure until the smoke of her offering table turns red. All will be forbidden to speak for the duration of the following sunrise until sundown.

strings.en: Find the source to drop the shield.

Dear Captain Magnus,

I regret to inform you that I, Lieutenant Snargle Goldclaw, would like to formally resign from the Lionguard. As much as shining armor and acting as a vigilant protector of the realm roused my sense of pride, seeing the violence that ensued today has shattered my faith. At my core I feel an emptiness and loss... Blood, everywhere.  
  
I have chosen another path. One that I know will supply the people with much-needed joy as they recover from the calamities that befell them. I am going to become...a writer. A writer of love and words that express love; hugs for the people, a kiss for the lost.  
  
Good luck with the fights to come. While you attack our foes on foot, I will go for their hearts with the pen.  

Snargle Goldclaw
